# Two call-less routes that derive the same name fail with a message that names
# both templates and says how to fix it. GET /a-b and GET /a/b both read
# ReadAB; a call, or a different path, makes the names differ.

! muxt generate
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error:
TemplateRoutePaths method name collision: templates "GET /a-b" and "GET /a/b" both produce method "ReadAB"; give one route a call to a different method, or change a path so the names derived from the routes differ
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:11: "GET /a-b" is defined here
$WORK/template.gohtml:2:11: "GET /a/b" is defined here
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /a-b"}}a{{end}}
{{define "GET /a/b"}}b{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
